title: Psionics detect NHI at Sedona base

tellings.quote: there are allegations that that base is NHI. I've had people who are psionic tell me that they have detected NHI in that in that area.

plain: A hidden base near Sedona, Arizona is alleged to be linked to non-human intelligence, meaning beings that are not human, and people with claimed mental sensing powers say they have felt that presence there. The Australian investigative journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels this in 2025, saying "there are allegations that that base is NHI" and that people "who are psionic" told him they detected it in that area. If true, it would place a non-human presence at a specific site in the United States.
